# Newsweek: Bigger AI Models Aren’t Always Better


In Newsweek’s AI Impact newsletter, Calix Chief Product Officer Shane Eleniak explains why “right-sized” AI is often the better fit for network problems. Smaller, task-specific models running closer to the data can handle security threats, network faults and subscriber issues without sending everything to a large centralized model. The feature covers Calix’s open-weight Communications Language Model, the planned Calix Gems for 2027, and why human approval still matters for actions that are hard to reverse.
